cand.title: Salon du livre 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and a credible hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is reduced by venue commitment or unresolved sourcing.

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Confirmed upcoming: 24–28 February 2027, 41st edition, Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This is the Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva, Founex/La Côte or Lausanne. The official venue listing and June 2026 exhibition regulations independently state the activity dates; these are not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. No
verifyPrev.venueText: 2027 fair officially scheduled at Palexpo; does not establish hotel inventory availability.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Named organizer contacts verified: Claire Damary, Chargée de projets Salon du livre, is listed on the exhibitor participation page addressing the 2027 programme; Natacha Bayard, directrice du salon, signs the professional page explicitly inviting participation in the 24–28 February 2027 edition. Both are relevant organizer entry points, not verified hotel-contract signatories.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition: 24–28 February 2027 at Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Geneva, Switzerland.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo is the published 2027 exhibition venue; this is not evidence of hotel accommodation commitments.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed. The reviewed organizer pages establish exhibitor participation and named organizer contacts, not an open hotel tender, incumbent hotel, room block or accommodation purchasing authority.
findings.organizationStructure: The venue lists Salon du livre de Genève as organizer. The 2027 exhibitor charter carries Palexpo SA identification; Claire Damary uses a palexpo.ch address. Do not equate venue management or exhibitor coordination with verified hotel-buying authority.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Claire Damary first using her published business email, identify YOTEL Geneva Lake as a Founex accommodation option, and ask who handles 2027 organizer, author and exhibitor accommodation, whether contracts already exist, and whether any small group requirement remains. Seek direction from Natacha Bayard through the published general organizer channel if necessary. This is a qualification approach, not a claim of available business.

supportingSources.claim: Claire Damary: named project manager, direct business contact and 2027-relevant exhibitor pathway.
supportingSources.factVsInference: Fact; accommodation-buyer referral relevance is an inference, not verified contract authority.

supportingSources.claim: Natacha Bayard is salon director on the professional page explicitly promoting 24–28 February 2027.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Ask Claire Damary for the named accommodation purchasing owner and the 2027 booking/contract status before treating this as sales-eligible lodging demand.
remainingUncertainties: Neither named contact is verified as the accommodation contract decision-maker.
Whether 2027 accommodation sourcing is open, already committed, decentralized to publishers or managed by another party remains unconfirmed.
No verified 2027 hotel room-block, peak-room requirement or incumbent accommodation hotel was established in the reviewed sources.
